title: NAIM: on-chain .agent names for AI agents
summary: Initialise NAIM config and a $NAIM token config, then register a .agent name and read the name-record PDA.
what: NAIM is an Anchor program for a .agent name registry and secondary market aimed at AI agents. An admin initialises a config PDA (treasury, fee tiers, registration and grace periods). Later instructions register and renew names, stake $NAIM for fee discounts, and list or buy names in $NAIM, SOL or USDC. Upstream is the program only; the hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment.
app_note: The fork has no first-party frontend. The page at /dapps/naim/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/naim/, switch to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare. Get free devnet SOL from faucet.solana.com if you need it.
try_steps.see: The page lists initialize, register_name, stake, list_name, buy_with_sol and more, and shows program 3ASKx88k…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: initialize is already done on this lab deployment. Fetch the config PDA (seeds ["config"]) and confirm admin, treasury and the registration period.
try_steps.see: admin and treasury are the lab wallet, registration_period=31536000, grace_period=2592000.

try_steps.do: If you try initialize again, or submit initialize with registration_period=0, the transaction should fail.
try_steps.see: account already in use, or InvalidConfig.
try_steps.ran: The lab run caught InvalidConfig for a zero period and a failed second initialize.

diagram:
admin ─ initialize(treasury, fees, periods) ─▶ Config PDA ["config"]
(later) admin ─ init_token_config($NAIM mint, fee split)
payer ─ register_name(name, sha256(name), uri) ─▶ NameRecord PDA ["naim", hash, ".agent"]
accounts: Admin, treasury, fee tiers, registration_period, grace_period.
Created by init_token_config; pins the $NAIM mint and fee split. Not exercised in this run.
Owner, resolver, metadata URI, expiry. Created by register_name.

instructions.name: initialize
steps: Admin-signed, once-only. Rejects registration_period <= 0 or grace_period < 0.

instructions.name: register_name
steps: Validates the name and that name_hash is sha256(name), collects a $NAIM fee, and writes the name and reputation PDAs.
Not exercised in this run (needs init_token_config).

innovation.title: A human-readable .agent name layer for AI-agent wallets
innovation.text: The interesting DeAI idea is a dedicated on-chain namespace and marketplace for agent identities (.agent names, metadata URIs, staking discounts), not just a raw pubkey. This lab run proves the once-only initialize foundation.
innovation.more: register_name, staking and the marketplace were not sent in this run.

frontend.title: Generic IDL console
steps: initialize is already confirmed; fetch config.
Later name instructions need a $NAIM mint.

exercises.title: Why is registration_period=0 rejected?
steps: Read the require! at the start of initialize.

exercises.title: What else is needed before register_name?
steps: Look at RegisterName accounts and collect_fee.
exercises.expect: init_token_config must exist, plus a $NAIM mint and the payer/treasury/stakers ATAs.
exercises.hint: register_name calls collect_fee on token accounts.

not_covered: Staking, renew, and the list/buy marketplace were not exercised. The registered name is unverified.
objectives: Explain what initialize writes to the config PDA.
Derive that PDA from the documented seeds.
State why register_name cannot run until init_token_config exists.
prereqs: A wallet on devnet with a little SOL.
Comfort with PDAs and Anchor init constraints.
